allow_credentials=True with allow_origins default '*' is an invalid CORS combination (browsers reject credentialed wildcard). Harmless today because auth uses Bearer tokens, but should be explicit origins.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 858 lines - consider splitting the SEO router (seo_* endpoints + _compute_live_report) into its own module.

_compute_live_report() loads up to 500 candidate and role docs into Python on every request to do counting; move to MongoDB aggregation ($group) and/or cache the result for N minutes before dataset grows.
seo_location_career() runs 2 role queries + 2 candidate queries + one company lookup per job (N+1); batch company lookups with a single $in query.
Route /seo/careers/{career_slug}/in/{location_slug} relies on a literal 'in' segment - a career slug named 'in' would be ambiguous; acceptable but worth a comment.
